title: HeadHunterPL
description: HeadHunter drops a player's head when they are killed by another player — collectable, configurable and ready to use out of the box.
body:
HeadHunter is a lightweight and fully configurable player head drop plugin for your Minecraft server. When a player is killed by another player, their head drops as a collectible item — simple, clean and working right out of the box.
Drop chance, messages and effects are fully controlled through a single config.yml. No database, no complex setup — just drop it in and go.
💀 Player Head Drops
When a player is killed by another player, their head drops at the death location. The killer and victim both receive a configurable chat message. Drop chance is fully adjustable — set it to 100% for guaranteed drops or lower it for a rare reward system.
🎁 Admin Head Command
Server admins can give any player's head directly via command — whether the player is online or offline.
/playerhead give <PlayerName>              → Adds the head to your own inventory
/playerhead give <PlayerName> <Target>     → Sends the head to another player
⌨️ Commands
CommandPermissionDescriptionDefault/playerhead give <player>headhunter.adminGive a player head🔒 OP/ph, /head—Aliases for /playerhead🔒 OP
🔒 Permissions
PermissionDefaultDescriptionheadhunter.adminOPUse /playerhead commandheadhunter.droponkilltrueHead drops when this player is killedheadhunter.nodropfalseExempts a player from dropping their head
⚙️ Config Features
yamldrop-chance: 100     # 0–100 percent — set to 100 for always, 0 to disable
killer-message: true
victim-message: true

Set drop chance from 0–100%
Toggle kill & death messages individually
All messages fully customizable with color codes
Exempt specific players from dropping via permission

## 🖥️ Compatibility

| Server Software | Version | Supported |
|---|---|---|
| Paper | 1.21 – 1.21.x | ✅ |
| Folia | 1.21 – 1.21.x | ✅ |
| Spigot | 1.21 – 1.21.x | ✅ |
| Purpur | 1.21 – 1.21.x | ✅ |
| CraftBukkit | 1.21 | ✅ |

Java 21 required.
